description: Look up the EXACT, version-locked command-frame API a generated Final POS app runs on: renderClient method signatures + params, CF* entity field lists, pub/sub topic event vocabularies, and worked examples. Pass one of method/entity/topic for a precise lookup, entity+field to confirm a field exists, query for fuzzy search, or the plural batch forms. Ground every renderClient call in this before writing it — fabricated fields/methods fail on real Render devices. Typed signatures and entity fields are authoritative; the worked examples come from upstream docs and are NOT typechecked, so where they disagree, trust the types. Results carry `traps` for known field-level gotchas.
name: flow_lookup_command_frame
title: Look up command-frame API
